Community Heart Fundraiser 2024

Join us for an evening of community, connection, and compassion

Saturday, June 15, 2024 • 5:00 PM

Event Details

📅 Date & Time

Saturday, June 15, 2024
5:00 PM – 9:00 PM

📍 Location

Riverside Community Center
1425 Oak Valley Drive
Springfield, IL 62701

🎫 Admission

$25 per person
or pay-what-you-can
All proceeds support local families

🍽️ What's Included

Light refreshments, live music, silent auction, and raffle draws

About Our Mission

Community Heart is dedicated to supporting families in our region who face unexpected hardship. Every year, we help hundreds of families with emergency assistance, food security, and access to essential services.

Why Your Support Matters

When crisis strikes—whether it's job loss, medical emergency, or temporary housing need—families need immediate help. Community Heart provides a safety net so no one faces these challenges alone.

  • $50 provides a week of groceries for a family of four
  • $150 covers emergency utility payments
  • $300 helps secure safe temporary housing
  • $500 supports job training and employment assistance

Last year, 87% of families we supported regained financial stability within 12 months. Your contribution makes this transformation possible.

RSVP for the Event

Reserve your spot by June 10, 2024. We look forward to seeing you!

Community Heart Fundraiser
Helping families in need across our region.
